newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BLACKBURN REPORTED SET TO SIGN CITKO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BLACKBURN REPORTED SET TO SIGN CITKO.

text.p: Polish striker Marek Citko is reportedly set to join English premier league side Blackburn Rovers in a deal worth four million pounds ($6.7 million).

Citko's current team Widzew Lodz has already fought off approaches from Inter Milan and Leeds United but, after failing to reach the latter stages of the European Cup, now look ready to sell their 21-year-old to Blackburn.

Citko, who scored against England in a World Cup qualifying game at Wembley in October, is expected to fly to Blackburn this week for talks over personal terms and to undergo a medical, according to a report in a British Sunday newspaper.
